# 1. Setup and data import
```{r}
## import libraries 
library(haven)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
clean_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "lx-leong/ec4305_e2_g7/main/data/nhis_clean_full.rds"
)

temp_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")

download.file(clean_url, temp_file, mode = "wb")

df <- readRDS(temp_file)

unlink(temp_file)
```


# 2. Sample checks
```{r missingness}

# Basic checks on the restricted sample
table(df$year)
range(df$age4, na.rm = TRUE)

with(
  df,
  table(post65, age4 >= 65, useNA = "ifany")
)

binary_vars <- c(
  "post65", "mcare", "covered2", "sawdr",
  "inhosp", "goodplus", "female",
  "wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh", "emp"
)

lapply(df[binary_vars], table, useNA = "ifany")

table(
  rowSums(df[c("wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh")]),
  useNA = "ifany"
)

summary(df$educ)
table(df$region, useNA = "ifany")
summary(df$wt)

stopifnot(
  all(between(df$year, 1992, 1996)),
  all(is.na(df$sawdr) | df$sawdr %in% c(0, 1)),
  all(is.na(df$inhosp) | df$inhosp %in% c(0, 1))
)

```

# 3. Missingness
```{r}
# Overall missingness
key_vars <- c(
  "age4", "mcare", "covered2", "sawdr", "inhosp",
  "goodplus", "poor_clean", "female",
  "wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh",
  "educ", "lowed_clean", "region", "year", "wt", "emp"
)

missing_table <- df %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(key_vars), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "n_missing"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_missing = 100 * n_missing / nrow(df)
  )

print(missing_table, n = Inf)

# Check the two outcomes separately by year
outcome_missingness <- df %>%
  select(year, sawdr, inhosp) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(sawdr, inhosp),
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(value)),
    missing_pct = 100 * mean(is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(outcome_missingness, n = Inf)
```

# 4. Survey-weighted descriptive statistics
```{r}
# Survey-weighted descriptive means and age profiles
# Counts and missingness diagnostics are unweighted
eda <- df %>%
  mutate(
    sawdr_observed = as.integer(!is.na(sawdr)),
    inhosp_observed = as.integer(!is.na(inhosp)),
    side = factor(
      if_else(age4 < 65, "Below 65", "65 and above"),
      levels = c("Below 65", "65 and above")
    ),

    region1 = as.integer(region == 1),
    region2 = as.integer(region == 2),
    region3 = as.integer(region == 3),
    region4 = as.integer(region == 4)
  )

profile_vars <- c(
  "mcare", "covered2",
  "sawdr", "inhosp", "goodplus", "poor_clean",
  "female", "wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh",
  "educ", "lowed_clean",
  "region1", "region2", "region3", "region4",
  "emp"
)

# Broad descriptive comparison, not an RD estimate
descriptive_table <- eda %>%
  filter(
    between(age4, 60, 70),
    !is.na(wt),
    wt > 0
  ) %>%
  select(side, wt, all_of(profile_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(profile_vars),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(variable, side) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_observed = sum(!is.na(value)),
    missing_pct = 100 * mean(is.na(value)),

    mean_value = if (all(is.na(value))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      weighted.mean(value, wt, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(descriptive_table, n = Inf)
report_labels <- c(
  mcare = "Medicare coverage (%)",
  covered2 = "Any insurance coverage (%)",
  sawdr = "Doctor visit in past year (%)",
  inhosp = "Overnight hospital stay (%)",
  goodplus = "Good or better health (%)",
  female = "Female (%)",
  educ = "Education, years",
  lowed_clean = "Below high school (%)",
  emp = "Employed (%)"
)

table1 <- descriptive_table %>%
  filter(variable %in% names(report_labels)) %>%
  mutate(
    report_value = if_else(
      variable == "educ",
      mean_value,
      100 * mean_value
    ),
    report_value = round(report_value, 1),
    variable = factor(
      variable,
      levels = names(report_labels),
      labels = unname(report_labels)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(variable, side, report_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = side,
    values_from = report_value
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable)

knitr::kable(
  table1,
  digits = 1,
  col.names = c("Variable", "Ages 60–<65", "Ages 65–70"),
  caption = "Survey-weighted descriptive statistics, NHIS 1992–1996"
)
```

# 5. Age profiles around the eligibility cutoff
```{r}
# Quarter-year profiles
age_profiles <- eda %>%
  filter(!is.na(wt), wt > 0) %>%
  select(age4, side, wt, all_of(profile_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(profile_vars),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(variable, age4, side) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observed = n(),
    mean_value = weighted.mean(value, wt),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

profile_labels <- c(
  mcare = "Medicare coverage",
  covered2 = "Any insurance",
  sawdr = "Doctor visit in past year",
  inhosp = "Overnight hospital stay",
  goodplus = "Good or better health",
  poor_clean = "Poor health",
  female = "Female",
  wnh = "White non-Hispanic",
  bnh = "Black non-Hispanic",
  hispanic = "Hispanic",
  onh = "Other non-Hispanic",
  educ = "Years of education",
  lowed_clean = "Below high school",
  region1 = "Region 1",
  region2 = "Region 2",
  region3 = "Region 3",
  region4 = "Region 4",
  emp = "Employed"
)

plot_profiles <- function(vars, title, percentage = TRUE) {

  plot_data <- age_profiles %>%
    filter(
      variable %in% vars,
      between(age4, 60, 70)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      plot_value = mean_value * if (percentage) 100 else 1
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(age4, plot_value, colour = side, group = side)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 65, linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ variable,
      scales = "free_y",
      labeller = as_labeller(profile_labels)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(title, " (1992–1996)"),
      x = "Age in years",
      y = if (percentage) {
  "Survey-weighted percentage"
} else {
  "Survey-weighted mean"
},

caption = paste(
  "1992–1996; annual person weights (wt).",
  "Variable-specific observed samples.",
  "Connected age-cell means, not fitted RD effects."
)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

plots <- list(
  coverage = plot_profiles(
    c("mcare", "covered2"),
    "Insurance coverage around age 65"
  ),

  utilisation = plot_profiles(
    c("sawdr", "inhosp"),
    "Healthcare utilisation around age 65"
  ),

  health = plot_profiles(
    c("goodplus", "poor_clean"),
    "Self-rated health around age 65"
  ),

  demographics = plot_profiles(
    c("female", "wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh"),
    "Demographic composition around age 65"
  ),

  education = plot_profiles(
    c("educ"),
    "Education around age 65",
    percentage = FALSE
  ),

  low_education = plot_profiles(
    "lowed_clean",
    "Below-high-school share around age 65"
  ),

  region = plot_profiles(
    c("region1", "region2", "region3", "region4"),
    "Regional composition around age 65"
  ),

  employment = plot_profiles(
    "emp",
    "Employment around age 65"
  )
)

for (p in plots) {
  print(p)
}
```

# 6. Outcome availability around age 65
```{r}
## response availability and age cell counts 
# Response availability around 65
response_profiles <- eda %>%
  filter(between(age4, 60, 70)) %>%
  select(
    age4, side,
    sawdr_observed, inhosp_observed
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(sawdr_observed, inhosp_observed),
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "observed"
  ) %>%
  group_by(outcome, age4, side) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    observed_pct = 100 * mean(observed),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_response <- ggplot(
  response_profiles,
  aes(age4, observed_pct, colour = side, group = side)
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 65, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ outcome,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = as_labeller(c(
      sawdr_observed = "Doctor-visit response available",
      inhosp_observed = "Hospital response available"
    ))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Outcome availability around age 65: 1992–1996",
    x = "Age in years",
    y = "Observed outcome (%)",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = "Denominator includes missing outcomes; formal RD check pending."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_response
```

# 7. Sample size by age
``` {r}
# Number of respondents at each quarter-year age
age_counts <- df %>%
  count(age4, name = "n")

p_age_counts <- ggplot(age_counts, aes(age4, n)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.20, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 65, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Sample size by quarter-year age: 1992–1996",
    x = "Age in years",
    y = "Number of respondents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_age_counts
```
